description:
Free appointment times at one venue for one service, over up to two weeks. For salons, clinics, studios and anywhere a guest books a named service with a provider. Use find_table_times for a restaurant instead.

Needs a service id from get_venue. Each returned time has an `at` label to show the guest and a `slotToken`. The token is the booking handle: it is signed, it expires in about 30 minutes, and it is the only way a time can be booked later. Pass it back exactly as given, never edited, and never reuse one from a different venue. An empty `times` array for a day means that day is genuinely unavailable, not that something failed.

Each day lists at most 10 times unless `maxPerDay` says otherwise, spread across the day; `omitted` says how many more exist. To answer "around 6pm" or "afternoons", send `near`, `partOfDay`, `notBefore` or `notAfter` instead of asking for everything.

days.description: How many consecutive days to search from that day, 1 to 14. Defaults to 3.

from.description: Which day to start from: the word "today", the word "tomorrow", or an exact calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD. Resolved against the venue's own current date, which is often not yours. Do not send a phrase like "next Tuesday" or a time of day; both are rejected.

maxPerDay.description: Most times to return per day, 1 to 40. Defaults to 10. Past it, the times are spread across the day (or nearest `near`) and `omitted` says how many were left out.

near.description: A 24 hour time as HH:MM, for example 19:00 for 7pm. When a day has more times than maxPerDay, keep the ones closest to this.

notAfter.description: Drop times later than this 24 hour HH:MM.

notBefore.description: Drop times earlier than this 24 hour HH:MM.

partOfDay.description: Only times in this part of the day: morning (before 12:00), afternoon (12:00 to 16:59), evening (17:00 on).

serviceId.description: One service id from this venue's get_venue result. Not a service name.

slug.description: The venue's booking slug, exactly as find_venues or get_venue returned it or as it appears in the venue's own booking link: the last path segment of gaplessly.com/book/<slug>, or the first label of <slug>.gaplessly.com. Not the business name; use find_venues to turn a name into a slug.

venue.description: Alias of `slug`, kept for existing clients. Send `slug`.

name: find_appointment_times
title: Find appointment times
